_comment: A pnpm monorepo on main/develop with a shared working tree. Abridged from the kit's origin repo — see .claude/sdlc.config.json there for the full version. Shows the four features the simple example does not: `when` (path-scoped gates), `expectNonZero` (a command that exits non-zero by design), `guard.extraDeny` (a repo-specific denial), and `postEdit` (immediate feedback).

gates.title: Rule 1 — core never imports a domain
gates.fix: The fix is a registration or a callback on the core side, never an import.

gates.title: Generated artefacts match the committed ones
gates.fix: pnpm registry:build, then stage the generated files in the same commit.

gates.title: Deterministic floor run
gates.fix: Exits non-zero BY DESIGN. The gate is the scorecard comparison that follows it.

extraDeny.reason: Every domain's build writes the same shared registry path, so this silently replaces the registry the router reads.

postEdit.remind: Declaration changed — generated artefacts are now stale. Run `pnpm registry:build` and commit the result in the same commit.
